summary: An interactive TOC workshop (Bhakti and Amrita Ghulati) mapped roughly 24 distinct professional roles across the six stages of a student's journey -- Discover, Decide, Prepare, Apply, Transition, Experience. Breakout groups sorted these roles and discussed friction points; the facilitators reported that 75% of participants identified 'university outreach yield targets vs. family cost reality' as the sharpest tension in the ecosystem, and closed with proposed rules of engagement (be explicit about who pays whom, respect professional hand-offs, stay in your lane).
keyInsights: Facilitators mapped roughly 24 distinct professional roles across the education-services ecosystem.
75% of participants identified university-outreach-yield-goals vs. family-cost-reality as the sharpest tension in the sector.
Proposed rule of engagement: respect professional hand-offs and stay in your lane of expertise.
